context: Riku tells Aoi about a museum field trip.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (博物館/商店/ドライブ/コーナー/橋) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 学校で、博物館に行ってきたよ!
lines.en: We went to a museum with school!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、どうやって行ったの?
lines.en: Nice, how did you get there?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バスでドライブして、橋を渡ったよ。
lines.en: We cruised by bus and crossed a bridge.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 博物館で、何が面白かった?
lines.en: What was interesting at the museum?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 恐竜のコーナーが、最高だった!
lines.en: The dinosaur corner was the best!
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 近くの商店で、お土産買った?
lines.en: Did you buy souvenirs at nearby shops?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 古い商店で、化石の模型を買ったよ。
lines.en: I bought a fossil model at an old shop.
lines.style: happy teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいなあ、私もその博物館行きたい!
lines.en: Lucky, I want to go to that museum too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
